title.zh: 卷284 列傳七十一 觉史满保 施世骠 蓝廷珍 林亮 欧阳凯
title.en: Volume 284 Biographies 71: Jue Shi Man Bao, Shi Shibiao, Lan Tingzhen, Lin Liang, Ou Yangkai
title.raw: 卷284 列傳七十一 觉史满保 施世骠 蓝廷珍 林亮 欧阳凯

sentences.zh: 列傳七十一

translations.literal: Biographies 71
translations.idiomatic: Biographies 71

sentences.zh: 覺羅滿保陳策施世驃藍廷珍從弟鼎元林亮何勉陳倫炯

translations.literal: Aisin Gioro Manbao, Chen Ce, Shi Shipiao, Lan Tingzhen, younger cousin Dingyuan, Lin Liang, He Mian, Chen Lunjiong
translations.idiomatic: Aisin Gioro Manbao, Chen Ce, Shi Shipiao, Lan Tingzhen, his younger cousin Dingyuan, Lin Liang, He Mian, and Chen Lunjiong

sentences.zh: 歐陽凱羅萬倉遊崇功

translations.literal: Ouyang Kai, Luo Wancang, You Chonggong
translations.idiomatic: Ouyang Kai, Luo Wancang, and You Chonggong

sentences.zh: 覺羅滿保，字鳧山，滿洲正黃旗人。

translations.literal: Aisin Gioro Manbao, style name Fushan, was a man of the Manchu Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Aisin Gioro Manbao, whose style was Fushan, came from the Manchu Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 康熙三十三年進士，選庶吉士，授檢討。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year of Kangxi he passed the metropolitan examination, was selected as a bachelor of the Hanlin Academy, and was appointed reviser.
translations.idiomatic: In 1694 he passed the metropolitan examination, entered the Hanlin Academy as a bachelor, and was appointed reviser.

sentences.zh: 累遷國子監祭酒，擢內閣學士，直經筵。

translations.literal: He was promoted in succession to Chancellor of the Imperial Academy, was elevated to Grand Secretary of the Grand Secretariat, and attended the imperial lectures.
translations.idiomatic: He rose in turn to Chancellor of the Imperial Academy, was promoted to Grand Secretary of the Grand Secretariat, and served at the emperor's lectures.

sentences.zh: 五十年，授福建巡撫。

translations.literal: In the fiftieth year he was appointed Grand Coordinator of Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: In 1711 he was appointed grand coordinator of Fujian.

sentences.zh: 疏言福州、興化、泉、漳等屬十六州縣皆瀕海要地，請揀選直省卓異官除授。

translations.literal: He memorialized that the sixteen prefectures and counties subordinate to Fuzhou, Xinghua, Quanzhou, Zhangzhou, and the like were all vital coastal places, and requested that outstanding officials from the metropolitan provinces be selected and appointed.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized that the sixteen prefectures and counties under Fuzhou, Xinghua, Quanzhou, Zhangzhou, and the like were all vital coastal posts, and asked that outstanding officials from the provinces be selected and assigned there.

sentences.zh: 御史璩廷祜論其不可，部議以為然。

translations.literal: Censor Qu Tingyou argued that this should not be done; the ministry deliberation agreed.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Qu Tingyou argued against the proposal, and the ministry agreed with him.

sentences.zh: 詔下九卿等再議，卒從滿保言。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Nine Chief Ministers and others to deliberate again; in the end Manbao's view was followed.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered the Nine Chief Ministers and others to reconsider; in the end they adopted Manbao's proposal.

sentences.zh: 五十四年，擢福建浙江總督，命巡海。

translations.literal: In the fifty-fourth year he was promoted to Governor-General of Fujian and Zhejiang and ordered to patrol the sea.
translations.idiomatic: In 1715 he was promoted to governor-general of Fujian and Zhejiang and charged with coastal patrol.

sentences.zh: 議自乍浦至南澳，沿海五千餘裡，建台、寨百二十七所，砲位千一百七十有八。

translations.literal: It was proposed that from Zhapu to Nan'ao, along more than five thousand li of coast, one hundred twenty-seven forts and stockades be built and one thousand one hundred seventy-eight gun emplacements established.
translations.idiomatic: The plan called for one hundred twenty-seven forts and stockades and one thousand one hundred seventy-eight gun emplacements along more than five thousand li of coast from Zhapu to Nan'ao.

sentences.zh: 別疏言：「鹿耳門為台灣咽喉，澎湖為廈門籓衛，安平鎮為水師三營重地，及海洋各口岸宜分極衝、次沖，築墩、台，設汛巡守；

translations.literal: In a separate memorial he said: "Lukang is the throat of Taiwan; Penghu is the outer defense of Xiamen; Anping Town is a key post of the three naval camps; and the various sea outlets should be divided into foremost and secondary points of danger, with mounds and forts built and garrison patrols established;
translations.idiomatic: In a separate memorial he wrote: "Lukang is the throat of Taiwan, Penghu guards Xiamen, and Anping Town is a key base of the three naval camps. The various sea outlets should be ranked as foremost or secondary points of danger, with redoubts and forts built and patrol garrisons posted;

sentences.zh: 並嚴察海船出入，禁漁船私載米糧、軍器。」

translations.literal: and sea vessels entering and leaving should be strictly inspected, and fishing boats forbidden to carry grain or weapons privately."
translations.idiomatic: sea traffic should be strictly inspected, and fishing boats forbidden to carry grain or arms in secret."

sentences.zh: 又言：「淡水、雞籠山為台灣北界，其澳港可泊巨艦百餘。

translations.literal: He also said: "Tamsui and Jilong Mountain mark Taiwan's northern border; their harbors can anchor more than a hundred large ships.
translations.idiomatic: He also wrote: "Tamsui and Jilong Mountain mark Taiwan's northern frontier; their harbors can hold more than a hundred large ships.

sentences.zh: 更進為肩豆門，沃野百里，番社交據。

translations.literal: Farther on is Jiandoumen, with a hundred li of fertile land where aborigine communities intermingle.
translations.idiomatic: Farther north lies Jiandoumen, with a hundred li of fertile land where aboriginal communities mingle.

sentences.zh: 請增置淡水營，設官駐防為後蔽。」

translations.literal: He requested that the Tamsui garrison be added, with officials stationed to guard as a rear screen."
translations.idiomatic: He asked that a Tamsui garrison be added, with officials posted there to secure the rear.

sentences.zh: 皆報可。

translations.literal: All were approved.
translations.idiomatic: All of this was approved.

sentences.zh: 六十年，鳳山民硃一貴為亂。

translations.literal: In the sixtieth year the Fengshan commoner Zhu Yigui raised rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: In 1721 the Fengshan commoner Zhu Yigui raised a rebellion.

sentences.zh: 台灣知府王珍苛稅濫刑，鳳山民黃殿、李勇、吳外等集數百人謀變，一貴素販鴨，託明裔以為渠。

translations.literal: The Taiwan prefect Wang Zhen imposed harsh taxes and arbitrary punishments; the Fengshan men Huang Dian, Li Yong, Wu Wai, and others gathered several hundred men to plot revolt. Yigui had sold ducks for a living and, claiming Ming descent, was made their leader.
translations.idiomatic: The Taiwan prefect Wang Zhen imposed harsh taxes and arbitrary punishments. Huang Dian, Li Yong, Wu Wai, and other Fengshan men gathered several hundred followers to plot revolt. Yigui, who had made his living selling ducks, claimed Ming descent and was made their leader.

sentences.zh: 劫岡山塘、檳榔林二汛，掠軍器，眾益聚，遂破縣城，進陷台灣。

translations.literal: They raided the Gangshan and Binglanglin posts, seized weapons, and as the crowd grew they broke the county seat and advanced to take Taiwan.
translations.idiomatic: They raided the Gangshan and Binglanglin posts, seized arms, and as their numbers swelled they stormed the county seat and went on to seize Taiwan.

sentences.zh: 總兵歐陽凱等率兵禦賊，師敗績，死之。

translations.literal: Regional Commander Ouyang Kai and others led troops to resist the rebels; the army was defeated and they died.
translations.idiomatic: Regional Commander Ouyang Kai and others led troops against the rebels, were defeated, and were killed.

sentences.zh: 台廈道梁文煊等走澎湖。

translations.literal: Taiwan-Xiamen Circuit Intendant Liang Wenxuan and others fled to Penghu.
translations.idiomatic: Taiwan-Xiamen circuit intendant Liang Wenxuan and others fled to Penghu.

sentences.zh: 滿保疏聞，督兵趨廈門，值淫雨，乘竹兜從數騎行泥淖中。

translations.literal: Manbao reported by memorial, led troops toward Xiamen, encountered heavy rain, and rode a bamboo litter with a few horsemen through the mud.
translations.idiomatic: Manbao reported the outbreak and hurried troops toward Xiamen. Heavy rain fell, and he rode a bamboo litter with only a few escorts through the mud.

sentences.zh: 比至，籍丁壯剽悍能殺賊者悉充伍，嚴申軍令，禁舟師毋登陸，民以不擾。

translations.literal: When he arrived he enrolled all able-bodied men bold enough to kill rebels into the ranks, strictly enforced military orders, forbade the naval forces to go ashore, and the people were not disturbed.
translations.idiomatic: On arrival he enrolled every able-bodied man bold enough to fight into the ranks, enforced discipline strictly, forbade the fleet to land ashore, and kept the populace from being harassed.

sentences.zh: 淡水營守備陳策使詣廈門乞援，滿保移會巡撫呂猶龍，遣兵自閩安渡淡水。

translations.literal: Tamsui Garrison Commander Chen Ce sent an envoy to Xiamen to beg aid; Manbao communicated with Grand Coordinator Lü Youlong and dispatched troops from Min'an to cross to Tamsui.
translations.idiomatic: Tamsui garrison commander Chen Ce sent an envoy to Xiamen begging for aid. Manbao notified Grand Coordinator Lü Youlong and sent troops from Min'an across to Tamsui.

sentences.zh: 未幾，南澳鎮總兵藍廷珍率舟師至，滿保命統水陸軍，會提督施世驃於澎湖，剋期進剿。

translations.literal: Before long Nan'ao Town Regional Commander Lan Tingzhen arrived with the fleet; Manbao ordered him to command the land and sea forces, joined Naval Commander Shi Shipiao at Penghu, and set a date to advance and suppress the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Nan'ao regional commander Lan Tingzhen arrived with the fleet. Manbao ordered a combined land-and-sea campaign, joined Naval Commander Shi Shipiao at Penghu, and set a date for the assault.

sentences.zh: 六月，世驃、廷珍攻鹿耳門，敗賊安平鎮，遂克台灣。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Shipiao and Tingzhen attacked Lukang, defeated the rebels at Anping Town, and then recovered Taiwan.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Shipiao and Tingzhen attacked Lukang, defeated the rebels at Anping, and recovered Taiwan.

sentences.zh: 上以台灣民附亂非本意，敕滿保招撫。

translations.literal: The emperor, considering that the Taiwan people had joined the rebellion against their true intent, ordered Manbao to offer pacification.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor held that the people of Taiwan had joined the revolt against their true wishes and ordered Manbao to offer pacification.

sentences.zh: 尋諸羅民楊旭等密約壯丁六百人，擒一貴及其黨十二人，獻世驃軍前，檻送京師，磔於市。

translations.literal: Soon the Zhuluo man Yang Xu and others secretly gathered six hundred stout men, seized Yigui and twelve of his followers, presented them before Shipiao's army, sent them to the capital in cages, and had them dismembered in the marketplace.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Yang Xu of Zhuluo and others secretly mustered six hundred men, seized Yigui and twelve of his followers, and presented them to Shipiao's army. They were sent to the capital in cages and dismembered in the marketplace.

sentences.zh: 是役，自出師迄事平凡七日。

translations.literal: In this campaign, from dispatch of troops until the affair was settled took only seven days.
translations.idiomatic: From the opening of the campaign until the affair was settled took only seven days.

sentences.zh: 上嘉滿保調度有方，加兵部尚書。

translations.literal: The emperor praised Manbao's skillful coordination and added to him the post of Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised Manbao's skillful coordination and promoted him to Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 尋疏言：「賊起，惟守備陳策鼓勵兵民，堅守汛地，待大兵進援，奮力效忠。」

translations.literal: Soon he memorialized: "When the rebels rose, only Garrison Commander Chen Ce encouraged soldiers and civilians, held firm the garrison post, awaited the main army's advance in relief, and strove loyally in service."
translations.idiomatic: He soon memorialized: "When the rebels rose, only Garrison Commander Chen Ce rallied soldiers and civilians, held his post firm, awaited the main army, and served with loyal exertion."

sentences.zh: 命擢台灣總兵。

translations.literal: He was ordered promoted to Taiwan Regional Commander.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered promoted to regional commander of Taiwan.

sentences.zh: 复疏劾珍縱役需索，致一貴乘機倡亂；

translations.literal: He again memorialized to impeach Zhen for letting his runners extort, causing Yigui to seize the opportunity and raise rebellion;
translations.idiomatic: He again impeached Zhen for letting his runners extort the people, giving Yigui his opening to raise rebellion;

sentences.zh: 文煊及所屬官吏一無備禦，退回澎湖，應奪官逮問，從之，文煊等論罪如律。

translations.literal: Wenxuan and the officials under him had made no defense, retreated to Penghu, and should be stripped of office and arrested for trial. This was approved, and Wenxuan and the others were sentenced according to law.
translations.idiomatic: and charged that Wenxuan and his subordinates had made no defense and fled to Penghu. They should be stripped of office and arrested. The court agreed, and Wenxuan and the others were sentenced according to law.

sentences.zh: 秋，台灣颶作，滿保以聞，諭：「台灣有司平日貪殘激變，及大兵進剿，殺戮之氣上乾天和，令速行賑恤。」

translations.literal: In autumn a typhoon struck Taiwan; Manbao reported it. An edict said: "The Taiwan officials were greedy and cruel in ordinary times and provoked rebellion; when the great army advanced to suppress them, the air of slaughter offended Heaven's harmony. Order swift relief and succor."
translations.idiomatic: That autumn a typhoon struck Taiwan. Manbao reported it, and the emperor directed: "Taiwan's officials were greedy and cruel in ordinary times and provoked this uprising. When the army marched in, the killing offended Heaven's harmony. Provide relief at once."

sentences.zh: 上杭民溫上貴往台灣從一貴得偽元帥札、印，還上杭，煽鄉人從賊。

translations.literal: The Shanghang man Wen Shanggui went to Taiwan, followed Yigui, obtained a false marshal's dispatch and seal, returned to Shanghang, and incited villagers to join the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Shanggui of Shanghang went to Taiwan, followed Yigui, obtained a forged marshal's commission and seal, returned home, and incited his neighbors to join the rebels.

sentences.zh: 聞一貴誅，走江西，結棚匪數百，謀掠萬載。

translations.literal: When he heard Yigui had been executed he fled to Jiangxi, gathered several hundred shed-bandits, and plotted to plunder Wanzai.
translations.idiomatic: When he learned that Yigui had been executed he fled to Jiangxi, gathered several hundred shed-bandits, and plotted to raid Wanzai.

sentences.zh: 知縣施昭庭集營汛剿捕，擒上貴及其黨十數人，並伏法。

translations.literal: Magistrate Shi Zhaoting assembled garrison troops to pursue and capture them, seized Shanggui and more than ten of his followers, and they were all executed.
translations.idiomatic: Magistrate Shi Zhaoting assembled garrison troops to hunt them down, seized Shanggui and more than ten of his followers, and had them all executed.

sentences.zh: 大學士白潢等條奏禁戢棚匪，滿保疏言：「閩、浙兩省棚民，以種麻靛、造紙、燒灰為業，良莠不一。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Bai Huang and others submitted detailed proposals to restrain shed-bandits; Manbao memorialized: "The shed-dwellers of Fujian and Zhejiang make their living growing indigo, making paper, and burning lime; good and bad are mixed.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Bai Huang and others submitted detailed proposals to restrain shed-bandits. Manbao memorialized: "The shed-dwellers of Fujian and Zhejiang live by growing indigo, making paper, and burning lime, and the good and bad are mixed among them.

sentences.zh: 令鄰坊保結，棚長若有容庇匪類，依律連坐。

translations.literal: Let neighboring wards and communities bind themselves in mutual guarantee; if a shed chief harbors bandits he shall be punished by joint liability according to law.
translations.idiomatic: Let neighboring communities bind themselves in mutual guarantee. If a shed chief harbors bandits, he shall be punished by joint liability under the law.

sentences.zh: 有司於農隙遍履各棚，嚴加稽察。

translations.literal: The local officials, in the slack season of farming, should visit every shed and inspect strictly.
translations.idiomatic: Local officials should visit every shed in the farming slack season and inspect them strictly.

sentences.zh: 浙江鄞、奉化等二十七縣，福建閩、龍巖等四十州縣，皆有棚民，宜如沿海州縣例，揀員題補。」

translations.literal: Twenty-seven counties such as Yin and Fenghua in Zhejiang and forty prefectures and counties such as Min and Longyan in Fujian all have shed-dwellers; officials should be selected and nominated for appointment as in the coastal prefectures and counties."
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-seven counties such as Yin and Fenghua in Zhejiang and forty prefectures and counties such as Min and Longyan in Fujian all have shed-dwellers. Officials should be selected and appointed there by the same rule used for coastal posts.

sentences.zh: 詔從之。

translations.literal: An edict approved this.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 雍正三年，卒官。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yongzheng he died in office.
translations.idiomatic: In 1725 he died in office.

sentences.zh: 遺疏言：「新任巡撫毛文銓未至，總督印信交福州將軍宜兆熊署理，並留解任巡撫黃國材暫緩起程，如舊辦事。」

translations.literal: His death memorial said: "The newly appointed Grand Coordinator Mao Wenquan has not yet arrived; the governor-general's seal should be entrusted to Fuzhou General Yi Zhaoxiong to act in his stead, and the relieved Grand Coordinator Huang Guocai should be kept from departing for the time being to conduct affairs as before."
translations.idiomatic: His death memorial read: "The newly appointed grand coordinator Mao Wenquan has not yet arrived. The governor-general's seal should be entrusted to Fuzhou general Yi Zhaoxiong to act in his stead, and relieved grand coordinator Huang Guocai should be kept from departing for the moment so that affairs may continue as before."

sentences.zh: 詔嘉其得體，下部議䘏；

translations.literal: An edict praised this as appropriate and ordered the ministry to deliberate on posthumous honors;
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised this as appropriate and ordered the ministry to deliberate on posthumous honors;

sentences.zh: 時尚書隆科多獲罪鞫訊，得滿保餽金交通狀，世宗諭責滿保諂隆科多、年羹堯，命毋賜卹予諡。

translations.literal: at that time Minister Longkodo was convicted and interrogated, and evidence was obtained of Manbao's gifts of gold and dealings with him; the Yongzheng Emperor rebuked Manbao for fawning on Longkodo and Nian Gengyao and ordered that no posthumous pension or posthumous title be granted.
translations.idiomatic: but at that time Minister Longkodo was convicted and interrogated, and evidence emerged of Manbao's gifts of gold and dealings with him. The Yongzheng Emperor rebuked Manbao for currying favor with Longkodo and Nian Gengyao and ordered that no posthumous pension or title be granted.

sentences.zh: 策，字鍾侯，福建晉江人。

translations.literal: Ce, style name Zhonghou, was a man of Jinjiang in Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Ce, whose style was Zhonghou, came from Jinjiang in Fujian.

sentences.zh: 由銅山守備調淡水。

translations.literal: He was transferred from Tongshan garrison commander to Tamsui.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred from garrison commander at Tongshan to Tamsui.

sentences.zh: 一貴陷台灣，策孤軍力守一隅。

translations.literal: When Yigui took Taiwan, Ce with a lone army strove to hold one corner.
translations.idiomatic: When Yigui seized Taiwan, Ce held his corner alone with a single garrison.

sentences.zh: 奸人苑景文入境煽誘，擒誅之。

translations.literal: The traitor Yuan Jingwen entered the territory to incite and entice; Ce seized and executed him.
translations.idiomatic: The traitor Yuan Jingwen crossed the border to incite rebellion; Ce seized and executed him.

sentences.zh: 師下台灣，滿保檄剿北路，复南嵌、竹塹、中港、後壟、吞霄、大甲諸社。

translations.literal: When the army descended on Taiwan, Manbao ordered him to suppress the northern route and recover the communities of Nanqian, Zhuqian, Zhonggang, Houlong, Tunxiao, Dajia, and others.
translations.idiomatic: When the army landed on Taiwan, Manbao ordered him to pacify the northern route and recovered the communities of Nanqian, Zhuqian, Zhonggang, Houlong, Tunxiao, Dajia, and others.

sentences.zh: 以功擢台灣總兵，加左都督。

translations.literal: For his merit he was promoted to Taiwan Regional Commander and given the additional rank of Left Commander-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: For his service he was promoted to regional commander of Taiwan and given the additional rank of Left Commander-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in office.

sentences.zh: 施世驃，字文秉，靖海侯瑯第六子。

translations.literal: Shi Shipiao, style name Wenbing, was the sixth son of Marquis Jinghai Lang.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Shipiao, whose style was Wenbing, was the sixth son of Marquis Jinghai Shi Lang.

sentences.zh: 康熙二十二年，世驃年十五，從瑯下台灣，委署守備。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year of Kangxi, Shipiao was fifteen; he followed Lang in taking Taiwan and was appointed acting garrison commander.
translations.idiomatic: In 1683, when Shipiao was fifteen, he followed Lang in the conquest of Taiwan and was appointed acting garrison commander.

sentences.zh: 台灣既定，以功加左都督銜，授山東濟南城守參將。

translations.literal: When Taiwan was settled he was given the rank of Left Commander-in-Chief for merit and appointed garrison deputy commander of Jinan city in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: After Taiwan was pacified he was given the rank of Left Commander-in-Chief for merit and appointed garrison deputy commander of Jinan in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 三十五年，聖祖親征噶爾丹，天津總兵岳昇龍薦世驃從軍。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fifth year the Sage Ancestor personally campaigned against Galdan; Tianjin Regional Commander Yue Shenglong recommended Shipiao to join the army.
translations.idiomatic: In 1696 the Kangxi Emperor campaigned in person against Galdan. Tianjin regional commander Yue Shenglong recommended Shipiao for service in the campaign.

sentences.zh: 召試騎射，命護糧運至奎素，從大將軍馬斯喀追賊至巴顏烏闌。

translations.literal: He was summoned to test his horsemanship and archery, ordered to escort grain transport to Kuisu, and followed the Grand General Fiyanggū in pursuing the enemy to Bayan Ulan.
translations.idiomatic: He was summoned to demonstrate horsemanship and archery, ordered to escort grain to Kuisu, and followed Grand General Fiyanggū in pursuit of the enemy to Bayan Ulan.

sentences.zh: 師還，假歸葬。

translations.literal: When the army returned he took leave to bury the dead.
translations.idiomatic: When the army returned he took leave to attend a funeral.

sentences.zh: 上褒世驃勤勞，命事畢仍還任。

translations.literal: The emperor praised Shipiao's diligent service and ordered that when the affair was finished he should still return to his post.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised Shipiao's diligent service and ordered that he return to his post when the funeral was done.

sentences.zh: 累遷浙江定海總兵。

translations.literal: He was promoted in succession to Zhejiang Dinghai Regional Commander.
translations.idiomatic: He rose in turn to regional commander of Dinghai in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 四十二年，上南巡，賜御書「彰信敦禮」榜。

translations.literal: In the forty-second year the emperor made a southern tour and bestowed an imperial inscription reading "Manifest Faith and Esteem Ritual" as a plaque.
translations.idiomatic: In 1703, during a southern tour, the emperor bestowed an imperial plaque inscribed "Manifest Faith and Esteem Ritual."

sentences.zh: 時海中多盜，世驃屢出洋巡緝，先遣裨將假商船餌盜，擒獲甚眾，斬盜渠江崙。

translations.literal: At the time pirates were numerous at sea; Shipiao repeatedly went out on patrol, first sending subordinate generals in merchant ships as bait for pirates, capturing very many, and beheading the pirate chief Jiang Lun.
translations.idiomatic: Pirates were numerous at sea in those years. Shipiao went out on patrol again and again, first sending subordinate officers in merchant ships as bait, capturing large numbers, and beheading the pirate chief Jiang Lun.

sentences.zh: 四十六年，上南巡，詢及擒斬海盜事，溫諭嘉獎，賜孔雀翎。

translations.literal: In the forty-sixth year, on a southern tour, the emperor inquired about capturing and beheading pirates, spoke warm words of praise, and bestowed a peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: In 1707, on another southern tour, the emperor asked about his capture and execution of pirates, spoke warm words of praise, and bestowed a peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 四十七年，擢廣東提督。

translations.literal: In the forty-seventh year he was promoted to Guangdong Provincial Commander.
translations.idiomatic: In 1708 he was promoted to provincial commander of Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 五十一年，調福建水師提督。

translations.literal: In the fifty-first year he was transferred to Fujian Naval Commander.
translations.idiomatic: In 1712 he was transferred to naval commander of Fujian.

sentences.zh: 六十年，硃一貴為亂，陷台灣。

translations.literal: In the sixtieth year Zhu Yigui raised rebellion and took Taiwan.
translations.idiomatic: In 1721 Zhu Yigui raised a rebellion and seized Taiwan.

sentences.zh: 世驃聞報，即率所部進扼澎湖，總督滿保檄南澳總兵藍廷珍等以師會。

translations.literal: On hearing the report Shipiao at once led his command to advance and hold Penghu; Governor-General Manbao ordered Nan'ao Regional Commander Lan Tingzhen and others to join forces with their armies.
translations.idiomatic: On hearing the news Shipiao at once led his command to Penghu. Governor-General Manbao ordered Nan'ao regional commander Lan Tingzhen and others to join him with their fleets.

sentences.zh: 眾議三路進攻。

translations.literal: The assembly debated a three-route attack.
translations.idiomatic: The commanders debated a three-pronged attack.

sentences.zh: 世驃謂南路打狗港在台灣正南，南風盛，不可泊；

translations.literal: Shipiao said the southern route through Dagou Harbor lay due south of Taiwan; when the south wind blew hard ships could not anchor;
translations.idiomatic: Shipiao argued that the southern route through Dagou Harbor lay due south of Taiwan and that when the south wind blew hard ships could not anchor there;

sentences.zh: 北路清風隙去府百餘裡，運餉艱；

translations.literal: the northern route through Qingfeng Gap was more than a hundred li from the prefectural seat and supply transport was difficult;
translations.idiomatic: that the northern route through Qingfeng Gap was more than a hundred li from the prefectural seat and supply would be difficult;

sentences.zh: 度賊必屯聚中路，宜直搗鹿耳門。

translations.literal: he judged the rebels would certainly mass in the central route and that Lukang should be struck directly.
translations.idiomatic: and that the rebels would surely mass along the central route, so Lukang should be struck directly.

sentences.zh: 時台地諸將吏皆退次澎湖，惟淡水守備陳策堅守汛地。

translations.literal: At the time all Taiwan generals and officials had withdrawn to Penghu; only Tamsui Garrison Commander Chen Ce held firm at his garrison post.
translations.idiomatic: By then all Taiwan's generals and officials had withdrawn to Penghu; only Tamsui garrison commander Chen Ce still held his post.

sentences.zh: 世驃遣游擊張駴等赴援，自統師出中路。

translations.literal: Shipiao sent Colonel Zhang Yan and others to relieve him and personally commanded the army on the central route.
translations.idiomatic: Shipiao sent Colonel Zhang Yan and others to relieve him and personally led the main force on the central route.

sentences.zh: 選勁卒，乘小舟，載旗幟，分伏南北港。

translations.literal: He selected crack troops, put them in small boats carrying banners and flags, and stationed them in ambush at the northern and southern harbors.
translations.idiomatic: He chose crack troops, loaded them into small boats with banners and flags, and hid them in ambush at the northern and southern harbors.

sentences.zh: 六月，抵鹿耳門。

translations.literal: In the sixth month they reached Lukang.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month they reached Lukang.

sentences.zh: 賊踞砲台以拒。

translations.literal: The rebels held the gun batteries to resist.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels held the gun batteries to block them.

sentences.zh: 世驃登樓船督戰，發砲中敵貯火藥器，火大熾，賊驚潰。

translations.literal: Shipiao boarded a tower ship to direct the battle; cannon fire struck the enemy's store of gunpowder, the blaze flared up, and the rebels fled in panic.
translations.idiomatic: Shipiao boarded a tower ship to direct the battle. Cannon fire struck the enemy's powder store, the blaze roared up, and the rebels broke in panic.

sentences.zh: 眾軍齊進，兩港悉樹我軍幟。

translations.literal: All the armies advanced together; both harbors raised our army's banners.
translations.idiomatic: The whole force advanced together, and our banners went up in both harbors.

sentences.zh: 賊不敢犯，揚帆直渡鯤身。

translations.literal: The rebels dared not attack; they set sail and crossed straight over Kun Shen.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels dared not engage and sailed straight across Kun Shen.

sentences.zh: 鯤身者海沙也，水淺，大舟不能過。

translations.literal: Kun Shen is sea sand; the water is shallow and large ships cannot pass.
translations.idiomatic: Kun Shen is a sandbar; the water is shallow and large ships cannot cross it.

sentences.zh: 是日海水驟漲八尺餘，舟乘風疾上，遂克安平鎮。

translations.literal: That day the sea water suddenly rose more than eight feet; the boats rode the wind swiftly forward and then took Anping Town.
translations.idiomatic: That day the tide suddenly rose more than eight feet. The boats rode the wind forward and took Anping.

sentences.zh: 翌日，戰，破賊。

translations.literal: The next day they fought and broke the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: The next day they fought and routed the rebels.

sentences.zh: 賊悉眾來犯，世驃遣守備林亮等進西港，游擊硃文等越七鯤身，自鹽埕、大井頭分道登陸趨台灣。

translations.literal: The rebels gathered all their forces to attack; Shipiao sent Garrison Commander Lin Liang and others to advance on Xigang, and Colonel Zhu Wen and others crossed the seven Kun Shen, landing in separate columns from Yancheng and Dajingtou to press toward Taiwan.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels massed their full strength to attack. Shipiao sent Garrison Commander Lin Liang and others toward Xigang while Colonel Zhu Wen and others crossed the seven Kun Shen sandbars and landed in separate columns from Yancheng and Dajingtou to advance on Taiwan.

sentences.zh: 世驃督將士指揮布陣擊賊，賊潰，遂復台灣。

translations.literal: Shipiao directed officers and soldiers in deploying formations and striking the rebels; the rebels were routed and Taiwan was recovered.
translations.idiomatic: Shipiao directed his officers and men in battle formation, routed the rebels, and recovered Taiwan.

sentences.zh: 一貴走諸羅，諸羅民縛以獻，賊黨擒斬略盡。

translations.literal: Yigui fled to Zhuluo; the people of Zhuluo bound him and presented him; rebel followers were seized and beheaded, nearly all.
translations.idiomatic: Yigui fled to Zhuluo, where the local people bound him and turned him over. His followers were hunted down and killed, nearly to the last man.

sentences.zh: 台灣南北兩路悉平。

translations.literal: The northern and southern routes of Taiwan were all pacified.
translations.idiomatic: The northern and southern routes of Taiwan were fully pacified.

sentences.zh: 詔優敘，賜世驃東珠帽、黃帶、四團龍補服。

translations.literal: An edict granted special commendation and bestowed on Shipiao an eastern-pearl hat, yellow belt, and four-clawed dragon surcoat.
translations.idiomatic: An edict granted him special commendation and bestowed an eastern-pearl hat, yellow belt, and four-clawed dragon surcoat.

sentences.zh: 未幾，以疾卒於軍。

translations.literal: Before long he died of illness in the army.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he died of illness in camp.

sentences.zh: 遺疏乞從父瑯葬福建，留妻子守墓，上悉許之。

translations.literal: His death memorial begged to be buried in Fujian with his father Lang and to leave his wife and children to guard the tomb; the emperor approved all.
translations.idiomatic: His death memorial asked to be buried in Fujian beside his father Lang and to leave his wife and children to tend the tomb. The emperor granted everything.

sentences.zh: 贈太子太保，諡勇果。

translations.literal: He was posthumously made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent with the posthumous title Yongguo (Brave and Resolute).
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent with the posthumous title Yongguo (Brave and Resolute).

sentences.zh: 雍正元年，世宗命予一等阿達哈哈番世職，以其子廷旉嗣。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng the Yongzheng Emperor ordered that a hereditary rank of First Class Adahafan be granted, and his son Tingfan succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: In 1723 the Yongzheng Emperor ordered a hereditary rank of First Class Adahafan for his line, and his son Tingfan succeeded.

sentences.zh: 世驃和易謙雅，治軍嚴明。

translations.literal: Shipiao was easygoing, gentle, and modest; in governing the army he was strict and clear.
translations.idiomatic: Shipiao was affable, modest, and courteous, yet governed his troops with strict discipline.

sentences.zh: 與瑯先後平台灣，皆以六月乘海潮異漲渡師，遂以成功。

translations.literal: He and Lang pacified Taiwan in succession; both in the sixth month rode an unusual rise of the sea tide to ferry their armies across and thereby succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: He and his father Lang pacified Taiwan in turn; both in the sixth month crossed on an unusually high tide and thereby succeeded.

sentences.zh: 藍廷珍，字荊璞，福建漳浦人。

translations.literal: Lan Tingzhen, style name Jingpu, was a man of Zhangpu in Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: Lan Tingzhen, whose style was Jingpu, came from Zhangpu in Fujian.

sentences.zh: 少習騎射，從祖理器之。

translations.literal: In youth he studied horsemanship and archery and followed his grandfather Li Qi.
translations.idiomatic: As a youth he trained in horsemanship and archery and followed his grandfather Li Qi.

sentences.zh: 入伍，自定海營把總累遷溫州鎮標左營游擊。

translations.literal: He entered the army, rose in succession from platoon commander in the Dinghai camp to colonel of the Left Battalion of the Wenzhou garrison standard.
translations.idiomatic: He entered military service and rose from platoon commander in the Dinghai camp to colonel of the Left Battalion of the Wenzhou garrison.

sentences.zh: 巡外洋，屢獲盜，盜皆畏避。

translations.literal: Patrolling the outer seas he repeatedly captured pirates, and pirates all feared and avoided him.
translations.idiomatic: On patrol in the outer seas he captured pirates again and again, until they all feared and avoided him.

sentences.zh: 以是為諸將所忌，讒於總督滿保，將劾之。

translations.literal: For this he was envied by the other generals, who slandered him to Governor-General Manbao and were about to impeach him.
translations.idiomatic: The other generals envied him for this, slandered him to Governor-General Manbao, and were about to impeach him.

sentences.zh: 會關東大盜孫森等竊遼陽巨砲、戰艦逸入海。

translations.literal: It happened that the great bandits of the northeast Sun Sen and others stole great guns and warships from Liaoyang and fled out to sea.
translations.idiomatic: Just then the great northeastern bandit Sun Sen and his followers stole heavy guns and warships from Liaoyang and fled to sea.

sentences.zh: 聖祖震怒，責沿海疆吏嚴緝。

translations.literal: The Sage Ancestor was greatly angered and rebuked the coastal frontier officials to pursue them strictly.
translations.idiomatic: The Kangxi Emperor was furious and ordered the coastal authorities to hunt them down without mercy.

sentences.zh: 廷珍出巡海，至黑水外洋與遇，力戰，盡獲森等九十餘人，及其船艦、砲械。

translations.literal: Tingzhen went out to patrol the sea, met them in the Black Water outer seas, fought fiercely, and captured all of Sen and more than ninety men, together with their ships and artillery.
translations.idiomatic: Tingzhen went to sea, met them in the Black Water outer seas, fought fiercely, and captured Sen and more than ninety of his men along with their ships and guns.

sentences.zh: 滿保按部至溫州，廷珍迎謁以告。

translations.literal: Manbao made an inspection tour to Wenzhou; Tingzhen met and reported to him.
translations.idiomatic: When Manbao made an inspection tour to Wenzhou, Tingzhen met him and reported what had happened.

sentences.zh: 滿保歎曰：「幾失良將！」

translations.literal: Manbao sighed and said: "I nearly lost a fine general!"
translations.idiomatic: Manbao sighed and said, "I nearly lost a fine general!

sentences.zh: 召入舟，厚撫之，亟疏薦，超擢福建澎湖副將。

translations.literal: He summoned him into his boat, treated him generously, quickly memorialized to recommend him, and promoted him by special order to Fujian Penghu Vice Commander.
translations.idiomatic: He summoned him aboard his boat, treated him generously, memorialized urgently to recommend him, and promoted him by special order to vice commander at Penghu in Fujian.

sentences.zh: 未幾，遷南澳總兵。

translations.literal: Before long he was transferred to Nan'ao Regional Commander.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was transferred to regional commander of Nan'ao.

sentences.zh: 六十年，硃一貴為亂，廷珍上書滿保策破賊狀，滿保令統戰船四百、將弁一百二十、官兵一萬二千，會提督施世驃於澎湖，剋期進剿。

translations.literal: In the sixtieth year Zhu Yigui raised rebellion; Tingzhen wrote to Manbao outlining how to defeat the rebels; Manbao ordered him to command four hundred warships, one hundred twenty officers, and twelve thousand soldiers and sailors, join Naval Commander Shi Shipiao at Penghu, and advance to suppress them on a set date.
translations.idiomatic: In 1721 Zhu Yigui rebelled. Tingzhen wrote to Manbao outlining how to defeat the rebels. Manbao ordered him to take four hundred warships, one hundred twenty officers, and twelve thousand troops, join Naval Commander Shi Shipiao at Penghu, and attack on a set date.

sentences.zh: 廷珍至澎湖，言於世驃曰：「賊皆烏合，不足憂，惟脅從至三十萬人，請檄示止殲渠魁，餘勿問。

translations.literal: When Tingzhen reached Penghu he said to Shipiao: "The rebels are all a rabble and not worth worrying about, but those coerced number as many as three hundred thousand. Please issue a proclamation that only the ringleaders are to be destroyed and the rest not questioned.
translations.idiomatic: When Tingzhen reached Penghu he told Shipiao, "The rebels are a rabble and not worth fearing, but as many as three hundred thousand people were coerced. Issue a proclamation that only the ringleaders are to be killed and the rest left alone.

sentences.zh: 則人人有生之樂，無死之心，可不血刃平也。」

translations.literal: Then every man will have the joy of life and no heart for death, and the land can be pacified without drawing swords."
translations.idiomatic: Then everyone will rejoice in life and lose the will to die, and the island can be pacified without bloodshed."

sentences.zh: 世驃從之。

translations.literal: Shipiao followed this.
translations.idiomatic: Shipiao agreed.

sentences.zh: 師至鹿耳門，賊扼險拒守。

translations.literal: When the army reached Lukang the rebels held the strategic points and resisted.
translations.idiomatic: When the army reached Lukang the rebels held the strategic points and resisted.

sentences.zh: 諸將林亮、董芳當前鋒，殊死戰，廷珍率大隊繼之，連戰皆捷。

translations.literal: Generals Lin Liang and Dong Fang served as vanguard and fought to the death; Tingzhen led the main body after them; in successive battles all were victorious.
translations.idiomatic: Generals Lin Liang and Dong Fang led the vanguard and fought desperately. Tingzhen followed with the main force and won battle after battle.

sentences.zh: 賊大潰，退保府治。

translations.literal: The rebels were routed in great numbers and retreated to hold the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels broke in rout and fell back to defend the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 世驃遣亮等自西港仔暗度，廷珍以大軍躡其後。

translations.literal: Shipiao sent Liang and others to cross secretly from Xigangzi; Tingzhen followed with the great army.
translations.idiomatic: Shipiao sent Liang and others to cross secretly from Xigangzi while Tingzhen followed with the main army.

sentences.zh: 賊在蘇厝甲，與亮等決戰，廷珍分兵馳赴之。

translations.literal: The rebels were at Sucuo Jia and fought a decisive battle with Liang and the others; Tingzhen divided his troops and hurried to their aid.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels were at Sucuo Jia fighting a decisive battle with Liang's force. Tingzhen split his troops and hurried to support them.

sentences.zh: 賊望見旗幟，戰稍卻，乘勝追逐，遂大潰。

translations.literal: The rebels saw the banners and their fighting slackened slightly; the army pressed the victory in pursuit and they were routed in great numbers.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels saw the banners, their resistance faltered, and the pursuers drove them into a complete rout.

sentences.zh: 夜駐犁頭標，設伏以待，賊果至，四面突擊，賊大亂，自相攻殺。

translations.literal: At night they encamped at Litou Biao and set an ambush; the rebels came as expected, were struck from all sides, fell into great disorder, and killed one another.
translations.idiomatic: That night they camped at Litou Biao and set an ambush. When the rebels came as expected, troops struck from all sides. The rebels panicked and began killing one another.

sentences.zh: 追敗之木柵仔，复敗之蔦松溪，遂入府城，秋毫無所犯，民大悅。

translations.literal: They pursued and defeated them at Muzhaizi, again defeated them at Niaosong Stream, then entered the prefectural city without harming the slightest thing; the people were greatly pleased.
translations.idiomatic: They routed them again at Muzhaizi and at Niaosong Stream, then entered the prefectural city without harming a single thing. The people were overjoyed.

sentences.zh: 一貴及其黨李勇、吳外等皆就擒。

translations.literal: Yigui and his followers Li Yong, Wu Wai, and others were all captured.
translations.idiomatic: Yigui and his followers Li Yong, Wu Wai, and others were all taken.

sentences.zh: 分遣諸將復南北二路，署台灣總兵。

translations.literal: He dispatched generals to recover the northern and southern routes and acted as Taiwan Regional Commander.
translations.idiomatic: He sent generals to recover the northern and southern routes and served as acting regional commander of Taiwan.

sentences.zh: 秋，南路阿猴林餘孽復起，討平之。

translations.literal: In autumn remnants in the southern route at Ahonglin rose again; he suppressed and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn rebel remnants at Ahonglin in the south rose again, and he put them down.

sentences.zh: 招降陳福壽等十數人，皆渠魁也。

translations.literal: He induced Chen Fushou and more than ten others to surrender; all were ringleaders.
translations.idiomatic: He induced Chen Fushou and more than ten other ringleaders to surrender.

sentences.zh: 未幾，世驃卒，廷珍攝提督。

translations.literal: Before long Shipiao died and Tingzhen acted as Provincial Commander.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Shipiao died, and Tingzhen served as acting provincial commander.

sentences.zh: 餘賊黃殿等以次擒滅。

translations.literal: The remaining rebels Huang Dian and others were captured and destroyed in turn.
translations.idiomatic: The remaining rebels, including Huang Dian, were hunted down and destroyed one after another.

sentences.zh: 六十一年，授台灣總兵。

translations.literal: In the sixty-first year he was appointed Taiwan Regional Commander.
translations.idiomatic: In 1722 he was appointed regional commander of Taiwan.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年，擢福建水師提督，加左都督，賜孔雀翎，予三等阿達哈哈番世職。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng he was promoted to Fujian Naval Commander, given the additional rank of Left Commander-in-Chief, bestowed a peacock feather, and granted a hereditary rank of Third Class Adahafan.
translations.idiomatic: In 1723 he was promoted to naval commander of Fujian, given the additional rank of Left Commander-in-Chief, bestowed a peacock feather, and granted a hereditary rank of Third Class Adahafan.

sentences.zh: 世宗褒廷珍忠赤，惟屢勉以操守。

translations.literal: The Yongzheng Emperor praised Tingzhen's loyal devotion but repeatedly exhorted him on integrity.
translations.idiomatic: The Yongzheng Emperor praised Tingzhen's loyal devotion but repeatedly urged him to keep his integrity.

sentences.zh: 二年，入覲，命赴馬蘭峪謁景陵，賞賚稠疊。

translations.literal: In the second year he came to audience, was ordered to go to Malanyu to pay respects at the Jing Mausoleum, and received rich rewards.
translations.idiomatic: In 1724 he came to court, was ordered to pay respects at the Jing Mausoleum at Malanyu, and received lavish rewards.

sentences.zh: 七年，病聞，遣醫診視。

translations.literal: In the seventh year word of illness came; physicians were sent to examine him.
translations.idiomatic: In 1729 word came that he was ill, and the court sent physicians to attend him.

sentences.zh: 尋卒，贈太子少保，諡襄毅。

translations.literal: Soon he died and was posthumously made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent with the posthumous title Xiangyi.
translations.idiomatic: He soon died and was posthumously made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent with the posthumous title Xiangyi.

sentences.zh: 子日寵，嗣世職，官銅山營參將。

translations.literal: His son Richong succeeded to the hereditary rank and served as garrison deputy commander of the Tongshan camp.
translations.idiomatic: His son Richong succeeded to the hereditary rank and served as garrison deputy commander of the Tongshan camp.

sentences.zh: 孫元枚，自有傳。

translations.literal: His grandson Yuanmei has his own biography.
translations.idiomatic: His grandson Yuanmei has his own biography.

sentences.zh: 族弟鼎元，字玉霖，力學負才。

translations.literal: His clansman younger brother Dingyuan, style name Yulin, studied hard and possessed talent.
translations.idiomatic: His clansman Dingyuan, whose style was Yulin, was a diligent scholar of real ability.

sentences.zh: 廷珍統師入台灣，鼎元參軍事，著平台紀略。

translations.literal: When Tingzhen commanded the army into Taiwan, Dingyuan took part in military affairs and wrote A Brief Account of Pacifying Taiwan.
translations.idiomatic: When Tingzhen led the army into Taiwan, Dingyuan served on his staff and wrote A Brief Account of Pacifying Taiwan.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年，詔舉文行兼優之士，貢入太學，有司以鼎元薦，大學士硃軾器之，用薦得召見。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng an edict called for men excellent in both learning and conduct to be presented to the Imperial Academy; the local officials recommended Dingyuan; Grand Secretary Zhu Shi valued him and through recommendation he was summoned to audience.
translations.idiomatic: In 1723 an edict called for men distinguished in both learning and conduct to enter the Imperial Academy. Local officials recommended Dingyuan; Grand Secretary Zhu Shi valued him, and on that recommendation he was summoned to audience.

sentences.zh: 上書陳時政，上嘉納。

translations.literal: He submitted a memorial on current policy and the emperor praised and accepted it.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted a memorial on current affairs, and the emperor praised and accepted it.

sentences.zh: 授廣東普寧知縣。

translations.literal: He was appointed magistrate of Puning in Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed magistrate of Puning in Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 居官有惠政，長於斷獄。

translations.literal: In office he had benevolent policies and excelled at deciding cases.
translations.idiomatic: In office he governed with kindness and excelled at deciding cases.

sentences.zh: 性伉直，坐事劾罷。

translations.literal: His nature was upright and blunt; he was impeached and dismissed for an affair.
translations.idiomatic: He was blunt and upright by nature and was impeached and dismissed over an affair.

sentences.zh: 總督鄂彌達白其誣，召詣京師。

translations.literal: Governor-General E'erjidari reported that he had been falsely charged and he was summoned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General E'erjidari reported that the charge was false, and he was summoned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 旋署廣州知府。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed acting prefect of Guangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed acting prefect of Guangzhou.

sentences.zh: 甫一月，卒。

translations.literal: After only one month he died.
translations.idiomatic: After only one month in office he died.

sentences.zh: 鼎元嘗論台灣善後策，謂諸羅宜畫地更設一縣，總兵不可移駐澎湖。

translations.literal: Dingyuan once discussed policies for Taiwan after pacification, saying Zhuluo should be divided to establish another county and the regional commander should not be moved to garrison Penghu.
translations.idiomatic: Dingyuan once proposed policies for governing Taiwan after the rebellion, arguing that Zhuluo should be divided to form a new county and that the regional commander should not be moved to Penghu.

sentences.zh: 後諸羅析縣曰彰化，更設北路三營，總兵官仍駐台灣，皆如鼎元言。

translations.literal: Later Zhuluo was divided into the county of Zhanghua, three northern-route camps were newly established, and the regional commander still garrisoned Taiwan—all as Dingyuan had said.
translations.idiomatic: Later Zhuluo was split off as Zhanghua county, three northern-route camps were established, and the regional commander remained in Taiwan—all as Dingyuan had urged.

sentences.zh: 林亮，字漢侯，福建漳浦人。

translations.literal: Lin Liang, style name Hanhou, was a man of Zhangpu in Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: Lin Liang, whose style was Hanhou, came from Zhangpu in Fujian.

sentences.zh: 少習騎射擊刺。

translations.literal: In youth he studied horsemanship, archery, and thrusting.
translations.idiomatic: As a youth he trained in horsemanship, archery, and close combat.

sentences.zh: 生長海濱，島澳險夷，舟航利鈍，靡不講求。

translations.literal: Growing up on the seacoast, he studied every aspect of islands and harbors, their dangers and ease, and the advantages and disadvantages of shipping.
translations.idiomatic: Raised on the coast, he studied every harbor and island, its dangers and advantages, and the strengths and weaknesses of shipping routes.

sentences.zh: 初授台灣水師把總，累遷澎湖協守備。

translations.literal: He was first appointed platoon commander in the Taiwan naval forces and was promoted in succession to garrison commander of the Penghu command.
translations.idiomatic: He was first appointed platoon commander in the Taiwan naval forces and rose to garrison commander of the Penghu command.

sentences.zh: 硃一貴陷台灣，官吏渡澎湖，居民洶懼。

translations.literal: When Zhu Yigui took Taiwan, officials crossed to Penghu and the inhabitants were alarmed and fearful.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhu Yigui seized Taiwan, officials fled to Penghu and the inhabitants were terrified.

sentences.zh: 將吏以孤島難守，僉議撤歸廈門，各遣家屬登舟。

translations.literal: The generals and officials, considering the lone island hard to defend, unanimously debated withdrawing to Xiamen and each sent their families aboard ship.
translations.idiomatic: The officers, thinking the isolated island could not be held, agreed to withdraw to Xiamen and sent their families aboard ship.

sentences.zh: 亮按劍厲聲曰：「朝廷疆土，尺寸不可棄！

translations.literal: Liang grasped his sword and said in a stern voice: "The empire's territory—not an inch may be abandoned!
translations.idiomatic: Liang gripped his sword and said in a stern voice, "The empire's territory—not an inch may be abandoned!

sentences.zh: 今鋒刃未血，相率委去，縱避賊刃，能逃國法乎？

translations.literal: Now before blades have drawn blood you would all lead one another in abandoning it; even if you escape the rebels' blades, can you escape the nation's law?
translations.idiomatic: Before a blade has even been bloodied you would abandon it together. Even if you escape the rebels' swords, can you escape the law?

sentences.zh: 請整兵配船，守禦要害，賊至，決死戰！

translations.literal: I ask that troops be arrayed and ships assigned to defend the vital points; when the rebels come, fight to the death!
translations.idiomatic: Array the troops, assign the ships, defend the vital points, and when the rebels come, fight to the death!

sentences.zh: 戰不捷，亮死，君等去未遲。」

translations.literal: If the battle is not successful, Liang dies; you gentlemen may leave—it will not be too late."
translations.idiomatic: If we do not prevail, let me die first; you may withdraw then.

sentences.zh: 乃馳赴海口，申號令，驅將吏家屬登岸，令敢言退廈門者斬。

translations.literal: He then galloped to the harbor mouth, proclaimed orders, drove the families of generals and officials ashore, and ordered that whoever dared speak of retreating to Xiamen be beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: He galloped to the harbor, issued orders, drove the officers' families ashore, and decreed death for anyone who spoke of retreating to Xiamen.

sentences.zh: 時糧絕餉匱，亮輸貲買穀，碾米給軍，制戰攻器械，俟師至。

translations.literal: At the time grain was exhausted and pay scarce; Liang contributed his own funds to buy grain, husked rice to supply the army, made weapons for attack, and awaited the army's arrival.
translations.idiomatic: Grain and pay were exhausted. Liang spent his own funds to buy grain, husked rice for the troops, made weapons, and waited for the main army.

sentences.zh: 提督施世驃、總兵藍廷珍以亮忠勇，令當前鋒，領舟師五百七十人抵鹿耳門。

translations.literal: Naval Commander Shi Shipiao and Regional Commander Lan Tingzhen, considering Liang loyal and brave, ordered him to serve as vanguard; he led five hundred seventy men of the fleet to Lukang.
translations.idiomatic: Naval Commander Shi Shipiao and regional commander Lan Tingzhen, valuing Liang's loyalty and courage, made him vanguard. He led five hundred seventy sailors to Lukang.

sentences.zh: 一貴黨蘇天威據砲台以拒，亮率六艦直進，發砲中敵，火起，斃賊無算。

translations.literal: Yigui's follower Su Tianwei held the gun batteries to resist; Liang led six ships straight forward, fired cannon and struck the enemy; fire rose and countless rebels were killed.
translations.idiomatic: Yigui's follower Su Tianwei held the batteries. Liang led six ships straight in, cannon fire struck the enemy, flames erupted, and countless rebels were killed.

sentences.zh: 乘勝進攻安平鎮，亮先登樹幟，賊潰走。

translations.literal: Pressing the victory he advanced on Anping Town; Liang was first to climb and raise the banner; the rebels fled in rout.
translations.idiomatic: Pressing the victory, he advanced on Anping. Liang was first ashore to raise the banner, and the rebels fled.

sentences.zh: 翌日，鏖戰鯤身，駕舟橫衝賊陣，復大敗之。

translations.literal: The next day he fought fiercely at Kun Shen, drove his boat across the rebel formation, and again routed them greatly.
translations.idiomatic: The next day he fought fiercely at Kun Shen, drove his boat through the rebel line, and routed them again.

sentences.zh: 賊退至府城，世驃令亮分兵自西港仔暗度拊其背，廷珍以軍繼進，大戰，賊死傷遍野，遂克府治。

translations.literal: The rebels retreated to the prefectural city; Shipiao ordered Liang to divide troops and cross secretly from Xigangzi to strike their rear; Tingzhen followed with the army; in a great battle rebels lay dead and wounded across the fields, and the prefectural seat was taken.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels fell back on the prefectural city. Shipiao ordered Liang to cross secretly from Xigangzi and strike their rear while Tingzhen followed with the main force. In the great battle rebels lay dead across the field, and the prefectural seat was taken.

sentences.zh: 亮功最，遷台灣參將。

translations.literal: Liang's merit was greatest; he was transferred to Taiwan Garrison Deputy Commander.
translations.idiomatic: Liang's merit ranked first, and he was promoted to garrison deputy commander of Taiwan.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年，敘平台灣功，加都督同知，予一等阿達哈哈番世職。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng, recounting the merit of pacifying Taiwan, he was given the rank of Vice Commander-in-Chief and granted a hereditary rank of First Class Adahafan.
translations.idiomatic: In 1723, in recognition of the pacification of Taiwan, he was given the rank of Vice Commander-in-Chief and granted a hereditary rank of First Class Adahafan.

sentences.zh: 是年秋，入京，上深嘉之，擢水師副將，賜孔雀翎。

translations.literal: That autumn he entered the capital; the emperor deeply praised him, promoted him to naval vice commander, and bestowed a peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn he went to the capital. The emperor praised him warmly, promoted him to naval vice commander, and bestowed a peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 二年，授台灣鎮總兵。

translations.literal: In the second year he was appointed Taiwan Garrison Regional Commander.
translations.idiomatic: In 1724 he was appointed regional commander of the Taiwan garrison.

sentences.zh: 亮以台灣初被兵，加意撫綏，整水陸兵防。

translations.literal: Liang, considering Taiwan had just suffered warfare, paid special attention to pacification and put in order land and sea defenses.
translations.idiomatic: Knowing Taiwan had just been ravaged by war, Liang paid special attention to pacification and reorganized the land and sea defenses.

sentences.zh: 又招撫生番一百八社、男婦一萬八百餘人。

translations.literal: He also induced one hundred eight raw aborigine communities and more than ten thousand eight hundred men and women to submit.
translations.idiomatic: He also induced one hundred eight aboriginal communities, more than ten thousand eight hundred men and women, to submit.

sentences.zh: 亮因番嗜色布、鹽、糖，遣吏歷各社齎賜之，因宣布德意，群番悅服。

translations.literal: Liang, because the aborigines loved colored cloth, salt, and sugar, sent officials through each community to carry gifts, proclaimed the court's benevolent intent, and the aborigine groups gladly submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Knowing the aborigines valued colored cloth, salt, and sugar, he sent officials through each community with gifts, proclaimed the court's benevolence, and won their willing submission.

sentences.zh: 五年，移浙江定海，卒於官，賜祭葬。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was transferred to Dinghai in Zhejiang, died in office, and was granted sacrificial rites and burial honors.
translations.idiomatic: In 1727 he was transferred to Dinghai in Zhejiang, died in office, and was granted state funeral honors.

sentences.zh: 何勉，字尚敏，福建侯官人。

translations.literal: He Mian, style name Shangmin, was a man of Houguan in Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: He Mian, whose style was Shangmin, came from Houguan in Fujian.

sentences.zh: 初授督標把總。

translations.literal: He was first appointed platoon commander of the governor's standard.
translations.idiomatic: He was first appointed platoon commander of the governor's standard.

sentences.zh: 康熙五十八年，薛彥文等聚後洋山為匪，勉奉檄捕擒之。

translations.literal: In the fifty-eighth year of Kangxi Xue Yanwen and others gathered at Houyang Mountain as bandits; Mian received orders and captured them.
translations.idiomatic: In 1719 Xue Yanwen and others gathered as bandits at Houyang Mountain. Mian received orders and captured them.

sentences.zh: 六十年，從提督施世驃討硃一貴，勉攻南路，擒其黨杜會三、蘇清等；

translations.literal: In the sixtieth year he followed Provincial Commander Shi Shipiao in suppressing Zhu Yigui; Mian attacked the southern route and captured his followers Du Huisan, Su Qing, and others;
translations.idiomatic: In 1721 he followed Provincial Commander Shi Shipiao against Zhu Yigui. Mian attacked the southern route and captured followers Du Huisan, Su Qing, and others;

sentences.zh: 又於北路獲黃潛等二十六人。

translations.literal: on the northern route he also captured Huang Qian and twenty-six others.
translations.idiomatic: on the northern route he also captured Huang Qian and twenty-six others.

sentences.zh: 明年，遷台灣鎮標千總。

translations.literal: The next year he was transferred to company commander of the Taiwan garrison standard.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he was promoted to company commander of the Taiwan garrison standard.

sentences.zh: 時一貴餘黨王忠等出沒內山，巡視台灣御史吳達禮督捕治，總兵藍廷珍檄勉偵緝。

translations.literal: At the time Yigui's remnant followers Wang Zhong and others appeared and vanished in the inner mountains; Taiwan Investigating Censor Wu Dali supervised pursuit; Regional Commander Lan Tingzhen ordered Mian to scout and capture them.
translations.idiomatic: Yigui's remnant follower Wang Zhong and others were raiding the inner mountains. Investigating censor Wu Dali of Taiwan supervised the hunt, and regional commander Lan Tingzhen ordered Mian to track them down.

sentences.zh: 遣降卒為導，入鳳山深箐中，獲賊黨劉富生，思拒捕，立擒之。

translations.literal: He sent surrendered soldiers as guides, entered the deep ravines of Fengshan, captured the rebel follower Liu Fusheng, who thought to resist arrest, and seized him at once.
translations.idiomatic: He sent surrendered soldiers as guides into the deep ravines of Fengshan, seized rebel follower Liu Fusheng when he tried to resist, and captured him on the spot.

sentences.zh: 擢北路營參將，予拖沙喇哈番世職。

translations.literal: He was promoted to garrison deputy commander of the Northern Route camp and granted a hereditary rank of Tuhalahafan.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to garrison deputy commander of the Northern Route camp and granted a hereditary rank of Tuhalahafan.

sentences.zh: 雍正四年，水連沙等社叛番蠢動，總督高其倬檄從台灣道吳昌祚按治。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Yongzheng the rebellious aborigines of communities such as Shuilian Sha stirred; Governor-General Gao Qisuo ordered him to follow Taiwan Circuit Intendant Wu Changzuo in investigating and punishing them.
translations.idiomatic: In 1726 rebellious aborigines of communities such as Shuilian Sha stirred. Governor-General Gao Qisuo ordered him to join Taiwan circuit intendant Wu Changzuo in suppressing them.

sentences.zh: 勉攻北港，番請降，水連沙二十五社悉平。

translations.literal: Mian attacked Beigang; the aborigines begged to surrender, and all twenty-five communities of Shuilian Sha were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Mian attacked Beigang. The aborigines sued for peace, and all twenty-five Shuilian Sha communities were pacified.

sentences.zh: 遷湖廣洞庭協副將。

translations.literal: He was transferred to vice commander of the Dongting command in Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to vice commander of the Dongting command in Huguang.

sentences.zh: 十年，貴州九股苗作亂，詔發湖廣兵二千協剿。

translations.literal: In the tenth year the Jiugu Miao of Guizhou rebelled; an edict dispatched two thousand Huguang troops to assist in suppression.
translations.idiomatic: In 1732 the Jiugu Miao of Guizhou rebelled, and an edict dispatched two thousand Huguang troops to assist in the campaign.

sentences.zh: 提督張正興檄勉領兵五百赴貴州，進攻交汪寨。

translations.literal: Provincial Commander Zhang Zhengxing ordered Mian to lead five hundred troops to Guizhou and advance to attack Jiaowang Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial commander Zhang Zhengxing ordered Mian to lead five hundred men to Guizhou and attack Jiaowang Stockade.

sentences.zh: 勉乘霧夾擊，苗敗遁，复據蓮花峰築屯。

translations.literal: Mian took advantage of fog to strike from both sides; the Miao were defeated and fled, then again held Lotus Peak and built a stockade.
translations.idiomatic: Mian struck from both sides in the fog. The Miao were defeated and fled, then reoccupied Lotus Peak and built a stockade.

sentences.zh: 時貴州提督哈元生自台拱移軍至，令勉攻其東。

translations.literal: At the time Guizhou Provincial Commander Ha Yuansheng moved his army from Taigong and ordered Mian to attack the east.
translations.idiomatic: Guizhou provincial commander Ha Yuansheng then moved his army from Taigong and ordered Mian to attack from the east.

sentences.zh: 勉先登奪隘，賊竄走，掩擊之，陣斬其渠，餘眾就擒。

translations.literal: Mian was first to climb and seize the pass; the rebels fled in disorder; he pursued and struck them, beheaded their leader in battle, and the rest were captured.
translations.idiomatic: Mian was first to scale the heights and seize the pass. The rebels broke and fled; he pursued, killed their leader in battle, and captured the rest.

sentences.zh: 擢雲南鶴麗鎮總兵，調臨元，復調廣東左翼。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Yunnan Heli Town Regional Commander, transferred to Linyuan, and again transferred to the Left Wing in Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to regional commander of Heli in Yunnan, transferred to Linyuan, and then to the Left Wing in Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 五年，調台灣，尋又移南澳，署福建水師提督。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was transferred to Taiwan, soon again moved to Nan'ao, and acted as Fujian Naval Commander.
translations.idiomatic: In 1737 he was transferred to Taiwan, soon moved to Nan'ao, and served as acting naval commander of Fujian.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十年，以疾乞休，詔解任回籍調治。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Qianlong, citing illness he begged to retire; an edict relieved him of office to return home for treatment.
translations.idiomatic: In 1745, citing illness, he asked to retire. An edict relieved him of office so he could return home for treatment.

sentences.zh: 尋召詣京師，以篤老，命原品休致。

translations.literal: Soon he was summoned to the capital; because he was aged and infirm he was ordered to retire with his former rank.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon summoned to the capital, but because he was aged and infirm was allowed to retire at his former rank.

sentences.zh: 十七年，卒，賜祭葬。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he died and was granted sacrificial rites and burial honors.
translations.idiomatic: In 1752 he died and was granted state funeral honors.

sentences.zh: 子思和，嗣世職。

translations.literal: His son Sihe succeeded to the hereditary rank.
translations.idiomatic: His son Sihe succeeded to the hereditary rank.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，复官台灣總兵。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year he again held office as Taiwan Regional Commander.
translations.idiomatic: In 1762 he again served as regional commander of Taiwan.

sentences.zh: 陳倫蜅，字次安，福建同安人。

translations.literal: Chen Lunjiong, style name Ci'an, was a man of Tong'an in Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Lunjiong, whose style was Ci'an, came from Tong'an in Fujian.

sentences.zh: 父昂，字英士，弱冠賈海上，習島嶼形勢、風潮險易。

translations.literal: His father Ang, style name Yingshi, in his early twenties traded on the sea and learned the forms of islands, and the dangers and ease of winds and tides.
translations.idiomatic: His father Ang, whose style was Yingshi, took to seaborne trade in his youth and mastered the shapes of islands and the hazards of wind and tide.

sentences.zh: 施琅徵台灣，徵從軍，有功，授游擊。

translations.literal: When Shi Lang campaigned against Taiwan he was recruited to follow the army, had merit, and was appointed colonel.
translations.idiomatic: When Shi Lang campaigned against Taiwan he was recruited into the army, served with distinction, and was appointed colonel.

sentences.zh: 累遷至碣石總兵，擢廣東右翼副都統。

translations.literal: He was promoted in succession to Jieshi Regional Commander and elevated to Vice Commander of the Right Wing in Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: He rose in turn to regional commander of Jieshi and was promoted to vice commander of the Right Wing in Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 嘗上疏言：「西洋治曆法者宜定員，毋多留，留者勿使布教。」

translations.literal: He once memorialized: "Westerners who manage the calendar should have a fixed quota; do not keep many; those kept should not be allowed to spread religion."
translations.idiomatic: He once memorialized: "Westerners who manage the calendar should be kept to a fixed quota. Do not retain too many, and those who remain must not be allowed to preach."

sentences.zh: 又以沿海居民困於海禁，將疏請弛之。

translations.literal: He also, because coastal residents were distressed by the maritime prohibition, was about to memorialize requesting its relaxation.
translations.idiomatic: He also planned to memorialize for easing the maritime prohibition, because coastal residents were suffering under it.

sentences.zh: 會疾作，命倫蜅以遺疏進，詔報可。

translations.literal: When illness came on he ordered Lunjiong to submit his death memorial; an edict approved it.
translations.idiomatic: When illness struck he ordered Lunjiong to submit his death memorial. An edict approved it.

sentences.zh: 倫蜅初以廕生授三等侍衛。

translations.literal: Lunjiong was first appointed a Third Rank Bodyguard through hereditary privilege.
translations.idiomatic: Lunjiong was first appointed a Third Rank Bodyguard through hereditary privilege.

sentences.zh: 雍正初，授台灣總兵，調廣東高廉。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yongzheng he was appointed Taiwan Regional Commander and transferred to Gaolian in Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Yongzheng reign he was appointed regional commander of Taiwan, then transferred to Gaolian in Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 坐事降台灣副將。

translations.literal: For an affair he was demoted to Taiwan Vice Commander.
translations.idiomatic: He was demoted to vice commander of Taiwan over an affair.

sentences.zh: 复授總兵，歷江南蘇松、狼山諸鎮。

translations.literal: He was again appointed regional commander and served in succession at the garrisons of Susong and Langshan in Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: He was again appointed regional commander and served at the Susong, Langshan, and other garrisons in Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 擢浙江提督。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Zhejiang Provincial Commander.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to provincial commander of Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in office.

sentences.zh: 昂疏並言：「臣詳察海上諸國，東海日本為大，次則琉球。

translations.literal: Ang's memorial also said: "Your servant has closely examined the countries of the sea: in the eastern sea Japan is greatest, next Ryukyu.
translations.idiomatic: Ang's memorial also stated: "I have closely examined the maritime powers. In the eastern sea Japan is greatest, followed by Ryukyu.

sentences.zh: 西則暹羅為最。

translations.literal: To the west Siam is foremost.
translations.idiomatic: To the west Siam is foremost.

sentences.zh: 東南番族文萊等數十小國，惟噶囉吧、呂宋最強。

translations.literal: Among the southeastern barbarian peoples are dozens of small countries such as Brunei; only Jakarta and Luzon are strongest.
translations.idiomatic: Among the southeastern maritime peoples are dozens of small states such as Brunei, but only Jakarta and Luzon are strongest.

sentences.zh: 噶囉吧為紅毛一種，中有英圭黎、干絲蠛、和蘭西、荷蘭、大小西洋各國。

translations.literal: Jakarta is of the red-haired kind; within it are England, Castile, France, Holland, and the countries of the greater and lesser Western oceans.
translations.idiomatic: Jakarta is a Dutch entrepôt where English, Castilian, French, Dutch, and other Western powers are represented.

sentences.zh: 和蘭西最凶狠，與澳門種人同派，習廣東情事。

translations.literal: The French are most fierce and cruel; they are of the same stock as the people at Macau and are versed in Guangdong affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The French are the fiercest; they are kin to the Macanese and know Guangdong affairs well.

sentences.zh: 請敕督、撫、關差諸臣防備，於未入港之先，取其火砲。

translations.literal: I ask that governors, coordinators, and customs officials be ordered to take precautions, and before they enter harbor seize their cannon.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that governors, coordinators, and customs officials be ordered to take precautions and seize foreign cannon before ships enter harbor.

sentences.zh: 另設所關束，每年不許多船並集。」

translations.literal: Separate stations should be set up to restrain them, and each year many ships must not be allowed to gather together."
translations.idiomatic: Separate stations should restrain them, and many ships must not be allowed to gather in one place each year.

sentences.zh: 下兵部，但令沿海將吏晝夜防衛，寢昂議。

translations.literal: It was sent to the Ministry of War, which only ordered coastal generals and officials to defend day and night; Ang's proposal was shelved.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial went to the Ministry of War, which merely ordered coastal officers to defend day and night and set Ang's proposal aside.

sentences.zh: 倫蜅為侍衛時，聖祖嘗召詢互市諸國事，對悉與圖籍合。

translations.literal: When Lunjiong was a bodyguard the Sage Ancestor once summoned him to inquire about the countries of mutual trade; his answers all matched the maps and records.
translations.idiomatic: When Lunjiong was a bodyguard, the Kangxi Emperor once summoned him to inquire about the trading nations, and his answers matched the official maps and records in every detail.

sentences.zh: 時互市諸國奉約束惟謹，獨昂、倫蜅父子有遠慮，憂之最早雲。

translations.literal: At the time the countries of mutual trade observed restraint with care; only Ang and Lunjiong, father and son, had far-sighted concern and worried earliest, it is said.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the trading nations observed restraint scrupulously, but Ang and his son Lunjiong alone looked ahead with foreboding and worried earliest of all.

sentences.zh: 歐陽凱，福建漳浦人。

translations.literal: Ouyang Kai, a man of Zhangpu in Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: Ouyang Kai came from Zhangpu in Fujian.

sentences.zh: 起行伍，累官江南蘇松水師營總兵。

translations.literal: He rose from the ranks and was promoted in succession to regional commander of the Susong naval camp in Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: He rose from the ranks to regional commander of the Susong naval camp in Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 康熙五十七年，調福建台灣鎮，以功加左都督。

translations.literal: In the fifty-seventh year of Kangxi he was transferred to the Taiwan garrison in Fujian and for merit was given the additional rank of Left Commander-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In 1718 he was transferred to the Taiwan garrison in Fujian and given the additional rank of Left Commander-in-Chief for merit.

sentences.zh: 六十年，硃一貴作亂，官軍遇賊於赤山，千總陳元戰死。

translations.literal: In the sixtieth year Zhu Yigui rebelled; the government army met the rebels at Chishan; Company Commander Chen Yuan died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In 1721 Zhu Yigui rebelled. Government troops met the rebels at Chishan, and company commander Chen Yuan was killed in battle.

sentences.zh: 賊進攻鳳山，把總林富戰死，守備馬定國自殺。

translations.literal: The rebels advanced on Fengshan; Platoon Commander Lin Fu died in battle; Garrison Commander Ma Dingguo killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels advanced on Fengshan. Platoon commander Lin Fu was killed in battle, and garrison commander Ma Dingguo took his own life.

sentences.zh: 凱率所部守備胡忠義、千總蔣子龍、把總林彥御之春牛埔；

translations.literal: Kai led his subordinates Garrison Commander Hu Zhongyi, Company Commander Jiang Zilong, and Platoon Commander Lin Yan to defend them at Chunniu Pu;
translations.idiomatic: Kai led his subordinates garrison commander Hu Zhongyi, company commander Jiang Zilong, and platoon commander Lin Yan to defend Chunniu Pu;

sentences.zh: 參將羅萬倉，游擊孫文元，城守游擊許雲，守備遊崇功，千總趙奇奉、林文煌，把總李茂吉率水師來會，力戰破賊。

translations.literal: Garrison Deputy Commander Luo Wancang, Colonel Sun Wenyuan, City Defense Colonel Xu Yun, Garrison Commander You Chonggong, Company Commanders Zhao Qifeng and Lin Wenhuang, and Platoon Commander Li Maoji led the naval forces to join them; they fought fiercely and broke the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Deputy commander Luo Wancang, colonels Sun Wenyuan and Xu Yun, garrison commander You Chonggong, company commanders Zhao Qifeng and Lin Wenhuang, and platoon commander Li Maoji brought the fleet to join them. They fought fiercely and routed the rebels.

sentences.zh: 次日，賊大至，凱力戰，與忠義子龍彥俱沒於陣，賊截凱首去。

translations.literal: The next day the rebels came in great force; Kai fought fiercely; he, Zhongyi, Zilong, and Yan all perished in battle, and the rebels cut off Kai's head and took it away.
translations.idiomatic: The next day the rebels came in overwhelming force. Kai fought to the end; he, Zhongyi, Zilong, and Yan all fell in battle, and the rebels cut off Kai's head and carried it away.

sentences.zh: 雲、崇功、奇奉、文煌同日戰死。

translations.literal: Yun, Chonggong, Qifeng, and Wenhuang died in battle on the same day.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Yun, You Chonggong, Zhao Qifeng, and Lin Wenhuang were killed in battle the same day.

sentences.zh: 茂吉被執，不屈，死。

translations.literal: Maoji was captured, refused to submit, and died.
translations.idiomatic: Li Maoji was captured, refused to submit, and was killed.

sentences.zh: 賊陷府治，萬倉戰死，文元奔鹿耳門投海死。

translations.literal: The rebels took the prefectural seat; Wancang died in battle; Wenyuan fled to Lukang and threw himself into the sea to die.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels seized the prefectural seat. Wancang was killed in battle, and Wenyuan fled to Lukang and drowned himself in the sea.

sentences.zh: 同死者游擊王九人、守備吳泰嵩。

translations.literal: Those who died with them were Colonel Wang Jiuren and Garrison Commander Wu Taisong.
translations.idiomatic: Colonel Wang Jiuren and garrison commander Wu Taisong died with them.

sentences.zh: 又有把總石琳，自汀州被檄至台灣，遇變被圍，死之。

translations.literal: There was also Platoon Commander Shi Lin, who had been ordered from Tingzhou to Taiwan, encountered the uprising, was surrounded, and died.
translations.idiomatic: Platoon commander Shi Lin had been ordered from Tingzhou to Taiwan, was caught in the uprising, surrounded, and killed.

sentences.zh: 六月，師克台灣。

translations.literal: In the sixth month the army recovered Taiwan.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month the army recovered Taiwan.

sentences.zh: 一貴既誅，獲其黨黃殿等，械送福州獄。

translations.literal: After Yigui was executed his follower Huang Dian and others were captured and sent in fetters to prison in Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: After Yigui was executed, his follower Huang Dian and others were captured and sent in chains to prison in Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年二月，賊破械斬關出，至下渡尾，都司閻威、守備楊士虎逐捕，殺數賊，被創死。

translations.literal: In the second month of the first year of Yongzheng the rebels broke their fetters, cut down the guards, and escaped; reaching Xiaduwei, Brigade Commander Yan Wei and Garrison Commander Yang Shihu pursued them, killed several rebels, and died of wounds received.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of 1723 the prisoners broke their fetters, killed the guards, and escaped to Xiaduwei. Brigade commander Yan Wei and garrison commander Yang Shihu pursued them, killed several rebels, and died of their wounds.

sentences.zh: 先後議卹，凱贈太子少保，廕守備；

translations.literal: Posthumous honors were deliberated in succession; Kai was posthumously made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and his son ennobled as garrison commander;
translations.idiomatic: Posthumous honors were granted in turn. Kai was posthumously made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, and his son was ennobled as garrison commander;

sentences.zh: 雲以下皆贈官、予世職有差。

translations.literal: from Yun downward all were granted posthumous offices and hereditary ranks in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: from Xu Yun downward all received posthumous offices and hereditary ranks in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 羅萬倉，甘肅寧夏人。

translations.literal: Luo Wancang, a man of Ningxia in Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: Luo Wancang came from Ningxia in Gansu.

sentences.zh: 官北路參將。

translations.literal: He held office as Northern Route Garrison Deputy Commander.
translations.idiomatic: He served as deputy commander of the Northern Route.

sentences.zh: 凱戰死，賊攻府城，萬倉督將卒登埤，發大砲擊賊，僕賊旗。

translations.literal: When Kai died in battle the rebels attacked the prefectural city; Wancang directed officers and soldiers onto the ramparts, fired great guns at the rebels, and knocked down the rebel banner.
translations.idiomatic: After Kai fell, the rebels attacked the prefectural city. Wancang directed his men onto the ramparts, fired great guns at the rebels, and knocked down their banner.

sentences.zh: 賊大至，萬倉出城與戰，逾溝墜馬，賊以竹篙刺其喉，猶揮刀殺賊乃死。

translations.literal: The rebels came in great force; Wancang went out of the city to fight; crossing a ditch he fell from his horse; the rebels pierced his throat with bamboo poles, yet he still swung his blade and killed rebels before he died.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels came in force he rode out to fight. Crossing a ditch he fell from his horse. Rebels pierced his throat with bamboo poles, yet he still swung his blade and killed several before he died.

sentences.zh: 妾蔣聞報，自經殉。

translations.literal: His concubine Jiang, on hearing the report, hanged herself in martyrdom.
translations.idiomatic: On hearing the news his concubine Jiang hanged herself in devotion.

sentences.zh: 遊崇功，字仲嘉，福建漳浦人。

translations.literal: You Chonggong, style name Zhongjia, was a man of Zhangpu in Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: You Chonggong, whose style was Zhongjia, came from Zhangpu in Fujian.

sentences.zh: 材力雄健。

translations.literal: His physique and strength were imposing.
translations.idiomatic: He was powerfully built and physically formidable.

sentences.zh: 從總兵蔡元鎮襄陽。

translations.literal: He followed Regional Commander Cai Yuanzhen to Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: He followed regional commander Cai Yuanzhen to Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 補右營把總，累遷福建長福營守備，分防長樂縣。

translations.literal: He was appointed platoon commander of the Right Battalion, was promoted in succession to garrison commander of the Changfu camp in Fujian, and was assigned to defend Changle county.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed platoon commander of the Right Battalion, rose to garrison commander of the Changfu camp in Fujian, and was assigned to defend Changle county.

sentences.zh: 濱海有磁澳，賊艘所出沒。

translations.literal: On the coast was Ci'ao, where pirate vessels appeared and vanished.
translations.idiomatic: On the coast lay Ci'ao, a haunt of pirate vessels.

sentences.zh: 崇功廉得狀，以兵二百伏隘口，入澳捕之。

translations.literal: Chonggong learned the facts through investigation, placed two hundred soldiers in ambush at the pass, and entered the inlet to capture them.
translations.idiomatic: Chonggong investigated and learned the facts, posted two hundred men in ambush at the pass, and entered the inlet to capture them.

sentences.zh: 賊棄舟登岸，伏發，擒十七人。

translations.literal: The rebels abandoned their boats and went ashore; the ambush was sprung and seventeen men were captured.
translations.idiomatic: The pirates abandoned their boats and came ashore. The ambush was sprung and seventeen men were captured.

sentences.zh: 自是島澳肅清。

translations.literal: From then on the islands and inlets were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: From then on the coastal islands and inlets were cleared.

sentences.zh: 長樂水災，崇功謁巡撫滿保，請發粟平糶，民食以濟。

translations.literal: When Changle suffered flood, Chonggong called on Grand Coordinator Manbao and requested grain be issued for relief sales; the people's food supply was thereby saved.
translations.idiomatic: When Changle suffered a flood, Chonggong called on Grand Coordinator Manbao and asked that grain be issued for relief sales. The people's food supply was thereby saved.

sentences.zh: 調台灣北路營守備，巡緝外洋，擒海賊陳阿尾等六十餘人。

translations.literal: He was transferred to garrison commander of the Taiwan Northern Route camp, patrolled the outer seas, and captured more than sixty pirates including Chen Awei.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to garrison commander of the Taiwan Northern Route camp, patrolled the outer seas, and captured more than sixty pirates including Chen Awei.

sentences.zh: 遷水師游擊。

translations.literal: He was transferred to naval colonel.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to naval colonel.

sentences.zh: 一貴作亂，崇功方出洋巡哨，聞報，率兵還赴安平，至則賊已熾，崇功急登岸赴敵。

translations.literal: When Yigui rebelled Chonggong was just out patrolling the sea; on hearing the report he led troops back to Anping; when he arrived the rebels were already strong, and Chonggong hurried ashore to meet the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: When Yigui rebelled Chonggong was at sea on patrol. On hearing the news he hurried back to Anping, but the rebels were already strong. He went ashore at once to fight.

sentences.zh: 其婿蔡章琦叩馬請一過家門區處眷屬，崇功不顧，躍馬揮眾，殺賊甚眾。

translations.literal: His son-in-law Cai Zhangqi knocked on his horse and begged to pass by his home door once to settle his family; Chonggong paid no heed, leaped on his horse, waved on the crowd, and killed very many rebels.
translations.idiomatic: His son-in-law Cai Zhangqi begged him to stop at his home to settle the family. Chonggong paid no heed, spurred his horse forward, led his men in, and killed many rebels.

sentences.zh: 五月朔，賊數万戰於春牛埔，凱戰死，崇功突圍衝擊，馬被創，遂歿於陣。

translations.literal: On the first day of the fifth month tens of thousands of rebels fought at Chunniu Pu; Kai died in battle; Chonggong broke out of encirclement and charged; his horse was wounded and he then perished in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the fifth month tens of thousands of rebels fought at Chunniu Pu. Kai was killed. Chonggong broke through the encirclement and charged, his horse was wounded, and he fell in battle.

sentences.zh: 章琦，國子監生。

translations.literal: Zhangqi was a student of the Imperial Academy.
translations.idiomatic: Zhangqi was a student of the Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 聞崇功戰沒，赴海死。

translations.literal: On hearing Chonggong had fallen in battle he went to the sea and died.
translations.idiomatic: On hearing that Chonggong had fallen in battle, he went to the sea and drowned himself.
